note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions: story chapters and missions first, then the stranger strands and the one missable meditation trophy, then activities, crime, collectibles and money, and finally 100% completion and the platinum. Sources: the official descriptions as listed by Insider Gaming and PushSquare; missable and story-window notes from EGamers and GTAScoop.

stages.goal: Finish the story: the opening mission, Chapters 1-4, the six named story missions and the final mission.
stages.summary: Play the story straight through. These 12 trophies unlock automatically as chapters and missions end, and none can be missed. Free roam continues after the final mission, so everything else can wait.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story

stages.goal: Finish the stranger strands while the story is still running, and meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1.
stages.summary: Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, and TechWiser (via EGamers) reports their windows are tied to story progress — do them during the story, not after it. Meditation is the one trophy flagged as possibly missable: one spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (GTAScoop), so meditate there early, then work through the other 17 spots as you explore.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Strangers and the one missable trophy

stages.goal: Try all 9 activity types, win races and drone races, gold the 42 shooting-range challenges, and build the stunt, challenge and arcade counts.
stages.summary: Activities are the long grind of the list. Sample every activity type once for Master of None, then chase the counts: 250 stunts, 50 challenges, 20 race wins, 14 drone-race locations and 42 gold shooting-range medals. The Shootist is rated one of the two hardest trophies (EGamers).
stages.title: Stage 3 — Activities, races and the range

stages.goal: Rob shops, banks, vaults, armored trucks and gang operations, escape the police with your partner, and pull off the stealth and stunt robberies.
stages.summary: Crime trophies need planning more than grinding: keep the wanted level alive across 3 shop robberies, escape after each of the 5 bank vaults, and rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. The jewelry store must be robbed without being detected.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Crime and robberies

stages.goal: Explore all 52 areas, discover 100 vehicles, WAiNK It at 100 locations, finish 3 card sets, and earn and spend the money.
stages.summary: Exploration and money finish together: exploring fills the 52-area and 100-vehicle counts, laundering Marked Bills funds the 8 garages, and everyday spending builds toward $100,000. A few of these trophies (Personal Best, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) have methods the community is still confirming — check the cited guides for the latest confirmed trigger.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Explore, collect and spend

stages.goal: Reach 100% completion on the game's own checklist, then watch the platinum pop.
stages.summary: A Long Road is the hardest trophy on the list (EGamers) and the last one most players earn: it needs the story, the strands, the collectibles and the activities together. PushSquare estimates the whole platinum hunt at up to 300 hours or more. When it pops, the platinum follows at once.
stages.title: Stage 6 — 100% completion and the platinum
